notes.title: 【Weekly Update】Goddess Castle – All-New Structure
notes.content: [p]This week the dev team overhauled the game’s overall UI layout. We removed several cluttered icons and reorganized the entry points to every system so they now follow a clear, logical flow. In addition, we’ve introduced a brand-new Home interface that consolidates all welfare content; expect even more rewards to be delivered through this Home system in future updates. Stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257289/77af5e16bfe42c901df2e9f20bfc28e3c4fee414.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 【Weekly Update】New Equipment and New Server!
notes.content:
This week, we have introduced new 110-level character equipment into the game, which can be obtained through level drops or by refreshing the black market. In addition, we have made the following optimizations:

- We have enhanced the BOSS models and special effects during BOSS battles, resulting in a smoother overall combat experience.

- The goddess skins that you already own will now be stacked for display, making management more convenient.

- We have fixed the issue where users couldn’t access the black market after reaching level 100.
We have optimized the overall game storage size.

- We have improved the display of the Goddess Gallery. If you own specific skins, they will now be highlighted.

- We have launched a new Diamond Amplifier event. Players who have been registered for a certain period of time can trigger the event and earn a large number of diamond rewards.

- A new server has been opened: S9-Sanctuary Rift.

notes.title: 【Important Update】Goddess vs. Dragon! 3D!
notes.content:
Dear players, thank you for your patience. After more than a month of hard work, we are excited to release this update. The details of the update are as follows:

1.The new 3D combat mode has been released and is first applied to the World Lord gameplay.

2.A new World Lord gameplay mode has been added. Players can challenge the World BOSS - Ignis every week and rank based on the damage dealt.

3.New equipment: Ignis' Wings, which can be obtained through the World Lord gameplay.

4.Seven new Goddess cards have been added, featuring different styles and qualities.

5.A new Goddess card shop has been introduced. Every 7 days, three cards will be randomly available for purchase.

6.Korean language version has been added.

7.A new pre-game storyline video has been introduced. New players can watch it upon their first entry to better understand the game's world.

8.The level cap has been increased to level 200.

notes.title: 【Important Update】Free to Claim Your Desktop Angel!
notes.content:
In this update, the Desktop Angel feature will be launched. A fully 3D controllable desktop companion will start with the game.

"Nice to meet you, this is an angel from another world. You can use the left mouse button to rotate, hold the right mouse button to drag, and use the mouse wheel to zoom. After the angel is launched, all players can experience it for free for 3 days. This time the angel avatar is launched, and in the future the angel will also have AI intelligence to interact with you."

notes.title: 【Updates & Outlook】World BOSS : the Fire Dragon is about to commence !
notes.content:
Update Content:
1.Added 7 new character skins, with 3 available through Crystal purchase and 4 obtainable via summoning.
2.Added a French language version.
3.Adjusted the UI to accommodate the length of various languages and clearly display the STEAM Trading Post button.

Future Outlook:
Currently, we are devoting the majority of our efforts to developing a brand-new World BOSS gameplay mode. This mode will feature 3D combat, with characters and monsters presented in 3D models instead of traditional card forms, significantly enhancing the combat experience.

notes.title: 【Weekly Update】New Skins and Siege Battle Maps!
notes.content:
1.Added 7 new character skins, combining Eastern and Western mythologies. Three of them can be obtained through crystals, and the other four can be acquired through summoning.

2.Added 2 new siege battle maps: Luminaopolis and Auroria.

3.Adjusted the reward values of the siege battle map control points. Occupying the highest point can now grant up to 100% base attack power, defense, and health bonuses.

4.In siege battles, up to 10 of the same goddess skins can be deployed in a single position, significantly increasing the usage rate of skins.

5.Fixed the translation bug in the rune interface.

6.Optimized the gemstone embedding interface to display gemstone names, making it easier for players to operate.

7.Optimized the battle report function to permanently display quick access entries for three cities.

8.In siege mode, the goddess skins that can be operated are now sorted by combat power from highest to lowest for easier manipulation.

9.Added a new crystal purchase card event. This event will last for two weeks, so please join in time.

notes.title: 【 Important Update】New Siege Gameplay!
notes.content:
1.Added a brand-new siege gameplay, where you can use character skins to occupy strongholds and gain character ability enhancements.
2.Added a new city: Roghaven. Occupying this city will grant an attack power bonus.
3.Added 7 new character skin cards, with 3 obtainable through crystals and 4 through Goddess chests.
4.Updated skill icons and displayed different theme colors based on skill type, making them easier to understand.
5.Fixed the bug where the rune interface was unusable.
6.Fixed some translation issues.
7.Updated the login interface, enhancing the visual effects.
8.The character skin card preview interface now allows direct viewing of high-definition large images.

notes.title: 【Weekly Update】Brand New World Map
【Xmas Update】A brand new gaming visual experience
notes.content:
1.A brand-new game combat interface with a fresh arrangement of character and monster cards, along with enhanced special effects to make battles more visually impactful.

2.Introduction of new combat backgrounds that will be coordinated with map gameplay, allowing the background to change with the map location to increase immersion.

3.A new click record function in the Goddess Summon interface, which will track the cumulative number of player clicks.

4.A new combo count feature in the Goddess Summon interface, which will record the player's combo count.

5.Fixed the issue where the rune system's diamond unlock could not be clicked.

6.Resolved the problem with the store Tips not displaying correctly according to the hierarchy.

7.New Christmas event added, where players can obtain Christmas trees through various battles and exchange them for rewards.

notes.title: 【Important Update】Unlock Your Goddess!
【Update Preview】Goddess Skins: A Dazzling Debut
【Weekly Update】New Sever, New optimizations.
notes.content:
[b]1.Multi-Server Setup Added:[/b] Players can now choose different servers to play on, with each server corresponding to a unique game character. We will open new servers as needed.([u]Existing players who have already registered will be defaulted to S1-Shadow Crypt, please select this server to enter the game.[/u])	

[b]2.Cloud Save Optimization:[/b] Players can now choose to overwrite local saves with cloud saves at any time.(Please ensure you select the save for the correct server!)	

[b]3.Fixed Backpack Overflow Issue: [/b]Resolved an issue where an overflowing inventory would not display properly.	

[b]4.Fixed Talent Details Overlap:[/b] Resolved text overlapping issues in the talent details interface.	

[b]5.Improved PC Window Switching:[/b] Switching windows on the PC will no longer interrupt battles, making it easier for players to enjoy seamless AFK gameplay.	

[b]6.Automatic BOSS Challenges:[/b] Boss challenges will now proceed automatically.(If the automatic challenge fails, manual intervention will be required.)	

[b]7.Android Mobile Version Released:[/b] you can get the beta version from the official Discord channel. Players can update their PC saves to their mobile phone through cloud saves; (first upload the latest save to the cloud from the PC, then download the cloud save on the mobile phone).

notes.title: 【Weekly Update】New Treasure System Launch
notes.content:
We update the game every week, and this week's update features a brand-new treasure system. Upon entering the game, players can receive 4 treasure chests, each with a countdown timer. Once the timer runs out, you can claim the corresponding rewards. Come and experience it in the game!
